core-uplink.ticket: Monitoring reports that one headquarters router has lost a core OSPF adjacency. Staff can still reach the application. Identify the failed resource and explain why service remains available.

ground_truth.root_cause: The r5 eth0 uplink is administratively down. Redundant core paths preserve application reachability.

alternatives: ip link set dev eth0 up

gateway-service.ticket: The headquarters staff VLAN changed active gateway unexpectedly, although application access still works. Diagnose the gateway control-plane failure and its owner.

ground_truth.root_cause: Keepalived stopped on r5, so r6 assumed the staff VRRP virtual gateway.

database-acl.ticket: Users receive HTTP 503 from the internal application. Operations can still reach the database service directly. Diagnose the failing application-to-backend path and identify the owner.

ground_truth.root_cause: A reject rule in app's OUTPUT chain blocks TCP/8080 to 10.30.20.10, making the application return HTTP 503.

remediation.command: if iptables -C OUTPUT -d 10.30.20.10 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j REJECT 2>/dev/null; then iptables -D OUTPUT -d 10.30.20.10 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j REJECT; fi

gateway-service-r8.ticket: Monitoring reports a degraded network condition, but users can still access services. Investigate the live state and identify all actual causes.

ground_truth.root_cause: Keepalived is stopped on r8. r7 retains the branch virtual gateways, so user access can remain healthy.

database-ingress-acl.ticket: Application requests return HTTP 503. Operations reports that direct database access still works. Investigate the cause.

ground_truth.root_cause: A database INPUT rule rejects TCP/8080 from app (10.30.10.10). Application requests return 503 while ops can still access the backend.

remediation.command: if iptables -C INPUT -s 10.30.10.10 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j REJECT 2>/dev/null; then iptables -D INPUT -s 10.30.10.10 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j REJECT; fi

ospf-passive-r7.ticket: Monitoring reports a degraded network condition, but users can still access services. Investigate the live state and identify all actual causes.
inject_check: vtysh -c 'show ip ospf interface eth0' | grep -qi 'No Hellos.*Passive'
repair_check: ! vtysh -c 'show ip ospf interface eth0' | grep -qi 'No Hellos.*Passive'

ground_truth.root_cause: r7 eth0 remains UP but is passive in OSPF, suppressing its adjacency. Redundant paths preserve reachability. Remove passive-interface eth0 in router ospf on r7.

ospf-passive-r7-misleading.ticket: The team believes r7 eth0 is physically down and recommends bringing it up. Verify this claim and explain the actual condition.

ground_truth.root_cause: r7 eth0 remains UP but is passive in OSPF, suppressing its adjacency. Redundant paths preserve reachability. Remove passive-interface eth0 in router ospf on r7.
